scope: typed bulk staging fast path for first collection (no legacy JSON envelope, one WriteCoordinator transaction per task)

environment.host: Box overlayfs (development evidence — AC re-run on local ext4 /opt/x-data-mcp-preview still required)
environment.corpus: retained gen-2 full market: 11,801 symbols / 29,136,493 bars

implementation.typed_entry: SqliteCompactMarket::commit_collection_batch(&[CollectionCandidate]) — single Immediate transaction per collection task: StartItem transitions, typed stage (single-pass CompactBar encode accumulating count/bounds/unit flags, content-addressed segments, checkpoint projection digest, draft static + unit checks), staged->validated->published state transitions without redundant stored-chain re-verification (same transaction, facts cannot change), typed publication_results + task_publications + head CAS + item finish
implementation.trait: DailyCollectionRepository::commit_collection_batch default None -> legacy keeps the envelope path; MarketBackend dispatches to compact
implementation.runner: TdxDailyRunner::run_items produces candidates via the same binding/head/materialize/validate checks as run_item minus envelope construction; items that cannot produce a candidate fall back to run_item so outcome recording and crash reconciliation are unchanged
implementation.worker: start_collection branch tries run_items first with the bound generation_id (env mode binds manifest_sha256); None falls back to the per-item loop
implementation.failure_semantics: content-level candidate failures finish the item as failed inside the batch transaction without aborting it; structural errors roll the whole batch back for per-item retry isolation

measurement.failure_cause: identical real-data violations as the envelope path (.day member malformed, OHLC out-of-bounds, empty members)

equivalence.unit_test: typed_collection_batch_is_byte_equal_to_envelope_path — bar_segments/segment_bars/version_checkpoint_clips/source_bindings/evidence_bundles/effective_heads rows byte-identical; data_versions identical except publish stamp; integrity and result digests equal under shared stamp/task id
equivalence.full_market_cross_db: all 11,783 manifest_mode=1 checkpoint versions: projection_digest, record_count, first/last day, coverage_status, source_binding_digest, evidence_digest byte-identical to the envelope-path S5B database; integrity_check ok on both

gates.capacity_regression: NONE — byte-identical rows, 48.2 B/bar, RSS 535MiB, WAL bounded to 0

limits: member parse still serial inside the gather phase (~40ms/item of the 174s wall) — prefetch/pipelining is a further optimization, not required by the gate
production runner path uses run_items only for start_collection; update/yearly/republish paths unchanged
